correctness.rationale: The claim is a finite linear-algebra statement. The verifier reconstructs the LCF graph, proves the metric shell data by exhaustive BFS, enumerates every length-four magnitude chain in degrees 2, 3, and 4 for all 324 ordered endpoint pairs, forms the smooth-point boundaries over F_2, verifies the chain condition, and computes exact bitset ranks. The endpoint dimensions are 0,0,2,0,1 for distances 0 through 4, and direct-sum ranks give global dimension 252. The claim is explicitly limited to F_2 and bidegree (3,4).

evidence: Asao-Hiraoka-Kanazawa prove vanishing of MH_{ell-j,ell} for 1<=j<=i when girth is at least 2i+5. For MH_{3,4}, j=1, so the stated vanishing threshold is girth at least 7; the Pappus graph has girth 6.

value.rationale: The bidegree (3,4) is the first off-diagonal position where the general girth theorem ceases to force vanishing at girth 6. The Pappus graph is a canonical cubic symmetric distance-regular girth-six graph and Levi graph of the classical Pappus configuration. The result therefore gives a motivated exact boundary-case benchmark, and the endpoint-distance profile is substantially more informative than a single global rank.
